phrases.text: The constitutional amendment would rewrite the section of the Kansas Constitution on who may vote.
Today the constitution says every citizen of the United States who is eighteen or older and lives in the voting area shall be deemed a qualified elector.
The amendment would say no person shall be deemed a qualified elector unless a citizen of the United States, eighteen or older, and living in the voting area.
The state's ballot does not include a cost estimate for the amendment.
Kansas publishes no official argument against the amendment.
Kansas publishes no official argument for the amendment.
The ballot says a yes vote would clarify that only a citizen of the United States is eligible to vote.
The ballot says a no vote would make no change, and the language concerning voter qualifications would remain the same.
